## Description

A clear and concise description of the bug.

## Steps to Reproduce

1. Go to '...'
2. Tap on '...'
3. See error

## Expected Behavior

What you expected to happen.

## Actual Behavior

What actually happened. Include any error messages shown in the app.

## Device and Environment

- **Device**: (e.g. Samsung Galaxy S23, Pixel 7, Chrome on Windows)
- **OS version**: (e.g. Android 14, Chrome 124)
- **App version**: (found in Profile → About)
- **Platform**: Android / Web

## Screenshots

If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the problem. Do NOT include screenshots that contain personal or sensitive information.

## Additional Context

Any other context about the problem (e.g. does it happen every time, only on certain content types, only after a specific action?).
